info.name: Protec UAT2 - Add-on Quotes (PCAR, P2W, PCV, GCV)
info.description: One quote per add-on for each product on protecuat2. Each add-on is added to a base quote built from an issued policy of the same product. Set accessToken; the persist test stores the quote in quoteResp for the calculate request. Add-ons that need a sum insured or input value may return no premium change; PAOCC currently fails in rating.

item.name: PCAR add-on quotes
item.description: Base PCAR quote plus each add-on; persist then calculate. Run in order.
